entities.summary: Tatsuno Kingo  was a Japanese architect born in Karatsu, Saga Prefecture, Kyushu. He was a Doctor of Engineering; conferred as Jusanmi and Kunsanto ; and served as dean of Architecture Department at Tokyo Imperial University.
